name: 调教控制台新版
htmlTemplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:-apple-system,"PingFang SC",sans-serif;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

.dv{position:relative;width:280px;height:580px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#2a0a1a 0%,#1a0510 40%,#0a0205 100%);border-radius:36px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #4a0a2a,0 0 0 5px #1a0510,0 0 40px rgba(255,30,100,0.25),0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,150,0.15)}

/* 背景粒子 */
.bg-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.bg-particle{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,100,150,.6);border-radius:50%;animation:floatUp linear infinite;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(255,100,150,.8)}
@keyframes floatUp{0%{transform:translateY(600px) translateX(0);opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}90%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-20px) translateX(20px);opacity:0}}

/* 年龄验证 */
.age-gate{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(10,2,5,0.98);z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;text-align:center;border-radius:36px}
.age-gate.hidden{display:none}
.age-icon{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:10px;animation:pulse 2s infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,30,80,.6))}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.1)}}
.age-title{color:#ff3366;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,51,102,0.6);letter-spacing:2px}
.age-warn{color:#ff8899;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:220px}
.age-warn b{color:#ff3366}
.age-btns{display:flex;gap:8px}
.age-btn{padding:8px 22px;border-radius:18px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:1px}
.age-btn.yes{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}
.age-btn.yes:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.age-btn.no{background:transparent;border:1px solid #555;color:#777}
.age-sub{color:#553344;font-size:7px;margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:1px}

.dv-content{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative;z-index:1}
.dv-content.show{display:flex}

/* 状态栏 */
.sb{height:30px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;font-size:9px;color:#ff99bb;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:600}
.sb .is{position:absolute;top:3px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:65px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:10px}

/* 顶部头部 */
.top{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(40,5,20,0.9),rgba(60,10,30,0.85),rgba(40,5,20,0.9));border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:relative}
.top-av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#aa0033);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,0.5);animation:avatarPulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes avatarPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,23,85,0.8)}}
.top-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.top-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.top-sub{color:#ff6688;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.top-vip{font-size:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff9500);color:#3d2700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;animation:vipShine 2s infinite}
@keyframes vipShine{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,215,0,.9)}}

/* 沉沦度状态条 */
.status-bar{padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.6);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);flex-shrink:0}
.status-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.status-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.status-lb{font-size:7px;color:#aa6677;letter-spacing:1px;width:36px;flex-shrink:0}
.status-prog{flex:1;height:6px;background:rgba(255,80,120,0.1);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.status-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .5s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.status-fill::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.4),transparent);animation:statusShine 2s infinite}
@keyframes statusShine{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.status-fill.lust{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff3366,#ff6699)}
.status-fill.obey{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9333ea,#c084fc)}
.status-fill.shame{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ec4899,#f9a8d4)}
.status-num{font-size:7px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700;min-width:24px;text-align:right}

/* 搜索 */
.search{padding:5px 8px;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.5)}
.search input{width:100%;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.search input:focus{border-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.4);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.2)}
.search input::placeholder{color:#553344}

/* 分类导航 */
.nav{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:5px 6px;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.4);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.05)}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav label{flex-shrink:0;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:8px;color:#996677;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);white-space:nowrap;transition:all .15s}
.nav label.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.25),rgba(255,80,120,0.2));color:#ff99bb;border-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.4);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}

/* 页面容器 */
.pgs{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.pg{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:absolute;inset:0}
.pg.on{display:flex}
.scr{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:6px 8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar{width:2px}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:2px}

/* 首页 - 等级展示 */
.level-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(60,10,30,0.6),rgba(40,5,20,0.4));border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.25);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.level-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:80px;height:80px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,215,0,.15),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.level-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-badge{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff9500);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.level-info{flex:1}
.level-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.level-st{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.level-cp{font-size:9px;color:#ffd700;font-weight:700}
.level-prog{height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-prog-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ff6b6b);transition:width .5s}

/* 签到 / 推荐 / 抽卡 三连排 */
.action-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.action-card{padding:8px 4px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);transition:all .15s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.action-card:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.action-card.signin{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,180,0,0.15),rgba(255,100,0,0.1))}
.action-card.signin.done{opacity:0.6}
.action-card.recommend{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.15),rgba(255,80,120,0.1))}
.action-card.draw{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(155,89,182,0.15),rgba(125,60,160,0.1))}
.action-ic{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:2px;display:block}
.action-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;font-weight:600}
.action-st{color:#aa6677;font-size:6px;margin-top:1px}

/* 今日推荐 */
.recommend-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.12),rgba(60,10,30,0.6));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.recommend-card:active{transform:scale(0.98)}
.recommend-tag{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;font-size:7px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;animation:tagGlow 2s infinite}
@keyframes tagGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,23,85,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,.9)}}
.recommend-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.recommend-ic{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.recommend-info{flex:1}
.recommend-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
.recommend-ds{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;line-height:1.3}

/* 场景选择器 */
.scene-wrap{margin-bottom:8px}
.scene-tt{color:#996677;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;padding-left:2px}
.scene-list{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px}
.scene-list::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.scene-item{flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);font-size:8px;color:#aa7788;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.scene-item.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.4)}

/* 分类网格 */
.section-tt{color:#ff99bb;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;margin:4px 2px 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.section-tt::before{content:'';width:3px;height:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-radius:2px}

.cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
.cat-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.06),rgba(60,10,30,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.12);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .15s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cat-cd:active{transform:scale(0.96);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}
.cat-cd::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,80,120,0.05) 50%,transparent 100%);pointer-events:none}
.cat-ic{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:3px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.3))}
.cat-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}
.cat-cnt{color:#774455;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}

/* 玩法卡片 */
.cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.04),rgba(60,10,30,0.2));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:5px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.cd:active{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08)}
.cd-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 8px 5px}
.cd-ic{font-size:16px;width:22px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.4))}
.cd-inf{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cd-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
.cd-lvl{font-size:6px}
.cd-ds{color:#996677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cd-tg{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-top:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-tg span{font-size:5px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);color:#aa6677;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.cd-rare{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;font-size:6px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}

.cd-bd{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows 0.25s ease;border-top:1px solid transparent}
.cd-bd.on{grid-template-rows:1fr;border-top-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.08)}
.cd-bd-inner{overflow:hidden}
.cd-bd-content{padding:6px 8px}
.cd-tx{color:#ffddee;font-size:7px;line-height:1.5;padding:5px 6px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.04);border-radius:5px;border-left:2px solid rgba(255,30,80,0.25);margin-bottom:4px;max-height:90px;overflow-y:auto}
.cd-tx b{color:#ff99bb}
.cd-bts{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-btn{flex:1;min-width:45%;padding:5px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;text-align:center;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s}
.cd-btn:active{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.2);transform:scale(0.96)}
.cd-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border:none}
.cd-btn.dn{background:rgba(100,200,100,0.15);border-color:rgba(100,200,100,0.3);color:#88dd88;pointer-events:none}

.variant-wrap{margin:4px 0}
.variant-tt{color:#996677;font-size:6px;margin-bottom:2px}
.variant-opts{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.variant-opt{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.12);color:#997788;font-size:6px;cursor:pointer}
.variant-opt.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}

/* 工具页 */
.tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.tool-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.08),rgba(60,10,30,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tool-cd:active{transform:scale(0.96)}
.tool-cd::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-20px;right:-20px;width:60px;height:60px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,30,80,0.15),transparent);border-radius:50%}
.tool-ic{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:4px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.tool-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;position:relative;z-index:1}
.tool-ds{color:#774455;font-size:6px;margin-top:2px;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* 称呼快捷池 */
.quick-list{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.quick-item{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s}
.quick-item:active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(0.95)}

/* 任务卡片 */
.task-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(60,10,30,0.5),rgba(40,5,20,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.task-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.task-ic{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0}
.task-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.task-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}
.task-ds{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.task-btn{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border:none;color:#fff;font-size:7px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
.task-btn.done{background:rgba(100,200,100,0.2);color:#88dd88;pointer-events:none}

/* 详情页 */
.detail-page{padding:6px}
.detail-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:6px;padding:3px 0}
.detail-hd{text-align:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.detail-ic{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.5))}
.detail-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.detail-lvl{color:#ff6688;font-size:9px;margin-top:2px}
.detail-ds{color:#996677;font-size:8px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.4}
.detail-sec{margin-bottom:8px}
.detail-sec-tt{color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;letter-spacing:1px}
.detail-sec-tt::before{content:'';width:2px;height:9px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-radius:1px}
.detail-tx{color:#ffddee;font-size:8px;line-height:1.6;padding:7px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.04);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.detail-bts{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.detail-btn{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.detail-btn:active{transform:scale(0.96)}
.detail-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}
.detail-btn.secondary{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);color:#ff99bb}

.reviews{margin-top:6px}
.review-item{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:3px}
.review-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:3px}
.review-user{color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;font-weight:600}
.review-stars{font-size:7px}
.review-txt{color:#bb99aa;font-size:7px;line-height:1.4}

/* 自定义 */
.custom-form{padding:6px}
.custom-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:1px}
.form-group{margin-bottom:6px}
.form-label{color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;margin-bottom:2px;display:block;font-weight:600}
.form-input{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.form-textarea{min-height:55px;resize:none}
.form-row{display:flex;gap:5px}
.form-row .form-group{flex:1}
.form-select{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.custom-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.custom-btn{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.custom-btn.save{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff}
.custom-btn.cancel{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);color:#ff99bb;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2)}

.fav-empty{text-align:center;padding:30px 0;color:#553344;font-size:9px}
.fav-empty-ic{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:0.5}

/* 特效 */
.fx-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:50;overflow:hidden;border-radius:36px}
.fx-particle{position:absolute;font-size:18px;animation:particleFade 1.3s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes particleFade{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-70px) scale(0.4) rotate(180deg)}}

/* 底部 */
.bar{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:5px 0 2px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,5,10,0.95),rgba(10,2,5,0.98));position:relative;z-index:2}
.bar label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;color:#774455;font-size:7px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;transition:all .15s}
.bar label .ic{font-size:14px;filter:opacity(.6)}
.bar label.on{color:#ff99bb}
.bar label.on .ic{filter:opacity(1) drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.6))}

.toast{position:absolute;bottom:55px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;opacity:0;transition:all 0.3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.4)}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

.home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(255,80,120,0.2);border-radius:999px;z-index:5}

/* 模态弹窗 */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:150;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.modal.show{display:flex;animation:modalFade .25s}
@keyframes modalFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.modal-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#2a0a1a,#1a0510);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;color:#ffccdd;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(255,30,80,0.3);max-width:240px;width:100%}
.modal-title{font-size:12px;color:#ff99bb;letter-spacing:2px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.modal-content{font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;color:#ddccdd;text-align:left;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;white-space:pre-wrap;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.modal-btns button{flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;font-size:9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700}
.modal-btns .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border:none}
.modal-btns .secondary{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);color:#ff99bb}

/* 抽卡弹窗 */
.draw-modal-card{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#2a0a1a,#0a0205);border:2px solid #ffd700;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,.4)}
.draw-result{text-align:center;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.draw-rare-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:6px}
.draw-rare-tag.N{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#888,#aaa);color:#fff}
.draw-rare-tag.R{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#6366f1);color:#fff}
.draw-rare-tag.SR{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a855f7,#c084fc);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(168,85,247,.6)}
.draw-rare-tag.SSR{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff6b00);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.7);animation:ssrShine 1s infinite}
@keyframes ssrShine{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.7)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,215,0,1)}}
.draw-card-ic{font-size:42px;margin:6px 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.6));animation:drawFloat 2s infinite ease-in-out}
@keyframes drawFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
.draw-card-nm{font-size:14px;color:#ffd700;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.draw-card-ds{font-size:8px;color:#aa8899;margin-top:4px}

/* 契约书 */
.contract-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fdf6e8,#e8d5b7);color:#3d2b1f;padding:14px;border-radius:8px;font-family:serif;position:relative;border:1px double #8b6332}
.contract-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1px solid rgba(139,99,50,.3);border-radius:5px;pointer-events:none}
.contract-tt{text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:#5c3a1f;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:3px;position:relative}
.contract-body{font-size:9px;line-height:1.8;color:#3d2b1f;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.contract-sign{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px dashed #8b6332;padding-top:8px;font-size:8px;color:#5c3a1f}
.contract-stamp{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:50px;width:50px;height:50px;border:2px solid #c41e3a;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#c41e3a;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;transform:rotate(-15deg);letter-spacing:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}

/* 关系档案 */
.relation-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.1),rgba(60,10,30,0.4));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;color:#ffccdd}
.relation-hd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.relation-cp{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#ff99bb;margin-bottom:4px}
.relation-days{font-size:8px;color:#aa6677}
.relation-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.rs-item{text-align:center;padding:8px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.rs-num{font-size:14px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700}
.rs-lb{font-size:7px;color:#996677;margin-top:1px}

/* 倒计时挑战 */
.timer-display{text-align:center;padding:16px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,30,80,0.1),transparent);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.timer-num{font-size:32px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,30,80,0.6);letter-spacing:4px}

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>')}
function showToast(msg){var t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show')},1800)}
function vibrate(ms){if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ms||30)}
function rand(arr){return arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)]}
function rnum(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min}

function spawnFx(emoji,x,y){
  var dv=document.querySelector('.dv');
  var rect=dv.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++){
    var p=document.createElement('div');
    p.className='fx-particle';
    p.textContent=emoji;
    p.style.left=(x-rect.left+rnum(-25,25))+'px';
    p.style.top=(y-rect.top+rnum(-15,15))+'px';
    p.style.animationDelay=(i*0.08)+'s';
    dv.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(function(el){el.remove()},1500,p);
  }
}

function getLevel(){var r=LEVELS[0];for(var i=0;i<LEVELS.length;i++){if(exp>=LEVELS[i].min)r=LEVELS[i]}return r}
function getLevelStars(lv){return '⭐'.repeat(lv||1)}
function getRareColor(r){return r||'N'}

function getAllPlays(){var all=[];CATS.forEach(function(c){(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).forEach(function(it){all.push({cat:c,item:it})})});customPlays.forEach(function(it){all.push({cat:{id:'custom',name:'自定义',icon:'✏️'},item:it})});return all}
function getPlayCount(){var cnt=0;CATS.forEach(function(c){cnt+=(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).length});return cnt+customPlays.length}
function isFav(name){return favList.indexOf(name)>-1}
function toggleFav(name){var idx=favList.indexOf(name);if(idx>-1)favList.splice(idx,1);else favList.push(name);try{localStorage.setItem('tj_favs',JSON.stringify(favList))}catch(e){}}

function updateStatusBar(){

  $('obeyBar').style.width=Math.min(100,obey)+'%';
  $('obeyNum').textContent=obey;
  $('shameBar').style.width=Math.min(100,shame)+'%';

}

function addStatus(l,o,s,e){
  lust=Math.min(100,lust+l);
  obey=Math.min(100,obey+o);
  shame=Math.min(100,shame+s);
  exp+=e;
  updateStatusBar();
  saveStatus();
}

function bindListEvents(){
  var s=$('listScr');
  s.querySelectorAll('.cd').forEach(function(cd){
    cd.onclick=function(e){
      var btn=e.target.closest('.cd-btn');
      var varOpt=e.target.closest('.variant-opt');
      if(varOpt){cd.querySelectorAll('.variant-opt').forEach(function(v){v.classList.remove('on')});varOpt.classList.add('on');curVariant=varOpt.dataset.vid;return}
      if(btn){
        var t=btn.dataset.t;var name=cd.dataset.name;var catId=cd.dataset.cat;
        var itm=null;
        if(catId==='custom')itm=customPlays.find(function(x){return x.name===name});
        else CATS.forEach(function(c){(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).forEach(function(it){if(it.name===name)itm=it})});
        if(!itm)return;
        if(t==='fav'){
          toggleFav(name);
          btn.textContent=isFav(name)?'💛已藏':'🤍收藏';
          if(isFav(name)&&!taskDone.fav1){taskDone.fav1=true;addStatus(0,0,0,8);showToast('任务完成 +8EXP')}else{showToast(isFav(name)?'已收藏':'已取消')}
          vibrate(20);return
        }
        if(t==='detail'){
          var cat=CATS.find(function(c){return c.id===catId})||{id:'custom',name:'自定义',icon:'✏️'};
          curDetail=itm;showPage('detail');renderDetail(cat,itm);return;
        }
        if(t==='c'||t==='u'){
          var txt=(t==='c'&&itm.tc)?itm.tc:(t==='u'&&itm.tu?itm.tu:null);
          if(!txt)return;
          var variantInfo='';
          if(curVariant&&itm.variants){var v=itm.variants.find(function(x){return x.id===curVariant});if(v)variantInfo='\n强度: '+v.name}
          var full=buildSendText(itm,t,variantInfo);
          try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:full},'*')}catch(e){}
          btn.textContent='✓已发';btn.classList.add('dn');vibrate(30);
          // 状态加分
          var lvAdd=(itm.level||1)*3;
          addStatus(lvAdd,lvAdd-1,lvAdd-2,(itm.level||1)*5);
          // 任务
          if(!taskDone.play1){taskDone.play1=true;addStatus(0,0,0,5);showToast('🎉 任务完成 +5EXP')}
          if(itm.fx){var rect=btn.getBoundingClientRect();spawnFx(itm.fx,rect.left,rect.top)}
          setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent=(t==='c'?'📤对Char':'📤对User');btn.classList.remove('dn')},2500);
          return
        }
      }
      var bd=cd.querySelector('.cd-bd');if(bd)bd.classList.toggle('on')
    }
  })
}

  try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（📜 我们签署了调教契约：\n\n'+content+'\n\n签署完毕。）'},'*')}catch(e){}
  $('contractModal').classList.remove('show');
  showToast('契约已签署 💕');
};

// 倒计时
var timerInterval=null,timerSec=1800,timerRunning=false;
function updateTimerDisplay(){
  var m=Math.floor(timerSec/60),s=timerSec%60;
  $('timerNum').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
$('timerStart').onclick=function(){
  if(timerRunning){
    clearInterval(timerInterval);timerRunning=false;
    $('timerLb').textContent='已暂停';
    this.textContent='继续';
  }else{
    timerRunning=true;
    $('timerLb').textContent='挑战中...';
    this.textContent='暂停';
    timerInterval=setInterval(function(){
      timerSec--;
      updateTimerDisplay();
      if(timerSec<=0){
        clearInterval(timerInterval);
        timerRunning=false;
        $('timerLb').textContent='挑战完成！';
        vibrate([200,100,200]);
        try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（⏱️ 倒计时挑战完成！）'},'*')}catch(e){}
      }
    },1000);
  }
};
$('timerStop').onclick=function(){
  clearInterval(timerInterval);timerRunning=false;timerSec=1800;
  updateTimerDisplay();
  $('timerModal').classList.remove('show');
  $('timerStart').textContent='开始/暂停';
};

// 年龄验证
$('ageYes').onclick=function(){
  $('ageGate').classList.add('hidden');
  $('dvContent').classList.add('show');
  $('tm').textContent=String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');

  updateStatusBar();
  renderHome();
};
$('ageNo').onclick=function(){$('ageGate').innerHTML='<div style="color:#553344;font-size:11px">已退出 👋</div>'};

})();
</script>

.ad-cal{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.04);border-left:2px solid #c41e1e;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;margin-bottom:6px}
.ad-cal-date{font-size:11px;color:#c41e1e;font-weight:700;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;min-width:45px;flex-shrink:0;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-cal-info{flex:1;font-size:11px;color:#ccc;line-height:1.5;font-style:italic}

/* 闹钟 */
.ad-alarm{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.03);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.ad-alarm-time{font-size:18px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:200;letter-spacing:1px;flex-shrink:0}
.ad-alarm-info{flex:1;margin-left:10px;font-size:10px;color:#888;line-height:1.4}
.ad-alarm-sw{width:24px;height:14px;background:#c41e1e;border-radius:8px;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-alarm-sw::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:2px;top:1px;width:11px;height:11px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}

/* 相册 */
.ad-album-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.ad-album-lb{font-size:9px;color:#888;min-width:42px}
.ad-album-bar{flex:1;height:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.ad-album-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c41e1e,#ff6b6b);box-shadow:0 0 4px #c41e1e}
.ad-album-num{font-size:10px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700;min-width:48px;text-align:right}

/* 蜡烛 */
.ad-candle{text-align:center;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(196,30,30,.06),transparent);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1)}
.ad-candle-flame{font-size:38px;animation:flameFlick 2s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,140,0,.6))}
.ad-candle.out .ad-candle-flame{animation:none;opacity:0.2;filter:grayscale(1)}
@keyframes flameFlick{0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg)}}
.ad-candle-tip{font-size:10px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:6px}
.ad-candle.out .ad-candle-tip{color:#c41e1e;font-style:italic}

/* 月亮 */
.ad-moon{text-align:center;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,255,255,.04),transparent);border-radius:12px}
.ad-moon-ic{font-size:38px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.25));animation:moonGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes moonGlow{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.25))}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.45))}}
.ad-moon-tx{font-size:11px;color:#888;font-style:italic;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.6}

/* 时间穿梭 */
.ad-timeline{padding:10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.08);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-tl-tt{font-size:9px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.ad-tl-slider{width:100%;height:3px;background:#1a0000;border-radius:2px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15)}
.ad-tl-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#444,#c41e1e);border-radius:2px;transition:width .3s}
.ad-tl-dot{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:11px;height:11px;background:#c41e1e;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 8px #c41e1e;transition:left .3s}
.ad-tl-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:8px;font-size:7px;color:#555;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-tl-current{text-align:center;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:#ccc;font-style:italic;min-height:34px;line-height:1.6}

/* 写信 */
.ad-write{background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-write-tt{font-size:10px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.ad-write textarea{width:100%;min-height:60px;background:#000;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.2);border-radius:6px;padding:8px;color:#ddd;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;resize:none;outline:none;line-height:1.5}
.ad-write textarea:focus{border-color:rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-write-btn{margin-top:8px;width:100%;padding:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c41e1e,#8b0000);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600}
.ad-write-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}

/* 隐藏 */
.ad-hidden-hint{text-align:center;padding:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border:1px dashed rgba(196,30,30,.25);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:9px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.6;user-select:none}
.ad-hidden-hint:active{background:rgba(196,30,30,.05);color:#c41e1e}
.ad-hidden-hint.progress{background:rgba(196,30,30,.08);color:#c41e1e}
.ad-hidden-content{display:none;background:rgba(196,30,30,.08);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;color:#ddd;line-height:1.8;font-style:italic;position:relative}
.ad-hidden-content.show{display:block;animation:hiddenReveal 1.5s}
@keyframes hiddenReveal{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(8px)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0)}}
.ad-hidden-content::before{content:'🔓 已解锁';position:absolute;top:6px;right:10px;font-size:8px;opacity:.5;letter-spacing:1px}

/* 关闭 */
.ad-close-btn{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.2);background:transparent;color:#666;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0;font-family:inherit}
.ad-close-btn:active{background:rgba(196,30,30,.06);color:#c41e1e}

/* 底部 */
.ad-nav{flex-shrink:0;height:50px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0a,#000);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.12);position:relative;z-index:2}
.ad-nav .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;padding:4px 4px;font-family:inherit;border-radius:6px}
.ad-nav .item .ic{font-size:15px;line-height:1;opacity:.3;transition:all .25s;filter:grayscale(1)}
.ad-nav .item .lb{font-size:7px;color:#444;letter-spacing:1px;transition:color .25s}
.ad-nav .item.on .ic{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(196,30,30,.7))}
.ad-nav .item.on .lb{color:#c41e1e}
.ad-nav .item:active{transform:scale(.92)}

.ad-home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.2);border-radius:999px;z-index:5}

/* Toast */
.ad-toast{position:absolute;bottom:65px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c41e1e,#8b0000);color:#fff;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:10px;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(196,30,30,.4)}
.ad-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
</style>

【风格要求】
1. 必须戳心戳肺，催泪到不行
2. 用具体细节代替"想你了"，如"看到便利店草莓牛奶习惯性拿了两盒"
3. 时间错位制造对比："第187天 / 还有47天就是你生日"
4. 物件依恋："你的牙刷还插在杯子里 第187天"
5. 未完成感：草稿、半碗饭、没寄出的信
6. 荒诞日常：明明该崩溃却在继续刷牙、上班
7. 凌晨3-5点是Char的"破防时段"
8. 必须贴合Char人设、关系阶段
9. 用第一人称（Char视角）

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:"PingFang SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

.ct-device{position:relative;width:280px;height:560px;border-radius:36px;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#3a2418 0%,#5c3a1f 30%,#8b6332 60%,#c4a070 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #c4a070,0 0 0 5px #2a1810,0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#fff8e8}

.ct-statusbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px 4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#fff8e8;flex-shrink:0}
.ct-dynamic-island{width:70px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:12px}

/* 进度条 */
.ct-progress{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 12px 8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.15);flex-shrink:0}
.ct-step{flex:1;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:2px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-step.done{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ffb000)}
.ct-step.cur{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);animation:stepPulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes stepPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.7}50%{opacity:1}}
.ct-step-lb{font-size:7px;color:#fff8e8;opacity:.7;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 2px}

.ct-pages{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-page{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:8px 12px 16px;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.ct-page.active{display:flex;animation:pgFade .35s}
.ct-page::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0}
@keyframes pgFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* 案件等级标签 */
.ct-level-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ct-level-轻案{background:rgba(34,197,94,.15);color:#22c55e;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3)}
.ct-level-中案{background:rgba(234,179,8,.15);color:#eab308;border:1px solid rgba(234,179,8,.3)}
.ct-level-重案{background:rgba(249,115,22,.15);color:#f97316;border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,.3)}
.ct-level-特大案{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:#ef4444;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3)}
.ct-level-死刑级{background:rgba(139,0,0,.25);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,0,0,.5);animation:dangerBlink 1s infinite}
@keyframes dangerBlink{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,0,0,.6)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,0,0,.9)}}

.ct-court-header{text-align:center;padding:10px 0 8px;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,215,0,.3);margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.ct-court-icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(255,215,0,.4))}
.ct-court-name{font-size:13px;color:#ffd700;letter-spacing:4px;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.ct-court-sub{font-size:9px;color:#fff8e8;opacity:.7;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:2px}

.ct-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,248,232,.95),rgba(255,240,210,.9));border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15);border:1px solid rgba(196,160,112,.3)}
.ct-card-label{font-size:8px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ct-card-body{font-size:11px;color:#5c4b3a;line-height:1.6}

.ct-crime{text-align:center;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,100,100,.95),rgba(255,150,100,.9));border-radius:10px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,80,80,.3);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-crime::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-50%;width:200%;height:200%;background:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.2),transparent);animation:shine 3s infinite}
@keyframes shine{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.ct-crime-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.95;position:relative;z-index:1}
.ct-crime-text{position:relative;z-index:1}

.ct-evidence{background:rgba(255,248,232,.92);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f;border-left:3px solid #ffd700}
.ct-evidence-title{font-size:9px;color:#a07530;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ct-evi-item{font-size:10px;color:#5c4b3a;padding:4px 6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:3px;line-height:1.4}
.ct-evi-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.ct-judge-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,200,.95),rgba(255,220,150,.9));border-left:3px solid #ffb000;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f;position:relative}
.ct-judge-card .judge-style-tag{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;font-size:7px;background:rgba(180,90,0,.15);color:#a07530;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
.ct-judge-card .judge-label{font-size:9px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}
.ct-judge-card .judge-body{font-size:11px;color:#5c4b3a;line-height:1.6}

/* 命运抽签 */
.ct-fortune{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(155,89,182,.85),rgba(125,60,160,.9));border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;text-align:center;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(125,60,160,.3)}
.ct-fortune:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.ct-fortune-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.9}
.ct-fortune-result{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;min-height:18px}

/* 辩护词 */
.ct-defense{background:rgba(135,206,235,.18);border:1px dashed rgba(135,206,235,.5);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#fff8e8;position:relative}
.ct-defense::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:10px;right:10px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(135,206,235,.8),transparent)}
.ct-defense-label{font-size:9px;color:#87ceeb;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ct-defense-body{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;font-style:italic;opacity:.95}

/* 陪审团 */
.ct-jury{background:rgba(255,248,232,.92);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f}
.ct-jury-title{font-size:9px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ct-juror{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(196,160,112,.25)}
.ct-juror:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ct-juror-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.ct-juror-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ct-juror-name{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#a07530;margin-bottom:2px}
.ct-juror-text{font-size:10px;color:#5c4b3a;line-height:1.5}

/* 弹幕 */
.ct-danmu-wrap{position:relative;height:30px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px}
.ct-danmu-track{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;animation:danmu 25s linear infinite;white-space:nowrap}
@keyframes danmu{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ct-danmu-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:9px;color:#fff8e8;padding:0 12px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.9}

/* 法条引用 */
.ct-law{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(60,40,20,.6),rgba(80,55,30,.7));border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.3);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.ct-law::before{content:'§';position:absolute;top:4px;right:8px;font-size:24px;color:rgba(255,215,0,.2);font-family:serif}
.ct-law-label{font-size:8px;color:#ffd700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}
.ct-law-text{font-size:10px;color:#fff8e8;line-height:1.5;font-style:italic;opacity:.95}

/* 判决结果 */
.ct-verdict-box{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:18px 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,248,232,.95),rgba(255,240,210,.9));border:2px solid rgba(196,160,112,.4);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f}
.ct-verdict-badge{display:inline-block;padding:8px 24px;border-radius:24px;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.ct-verdict-badge.guilty{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#b91c1c);color:#fff}
.ct-verdict-badge.innocent{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22c55e,#15803d);color:#fff}
.ct-verdict-badge.partial{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eab308,#ca8a04);color:#fff}
.ct-verdict-detail{font-size:11px;color:#5c4b3a;line-height:1.6}

/* 印章 */
.ct-seal{position:absolute;right:-8px;top:-8px;width:60px;height:60px;border:2.5px solid #c41e3a;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#c41e3a;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;transform:rotate(-15deg) scale(0);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);letter-spacing:1px;text-align:center;line-height:1.1}
.ct-seal.show{transform:rotate(-15deg) scale(1)}

/* 量刑转盘 */
.ct-punish-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,230,200,.9),rgba(255,210,170,.85));border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f}
.ct-punish-label{font-size:9px;color:#a04030;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ct-punish-main{font-size:11px;color:#5c4b3a;line-height:1.6;padding:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ct-punish-extra{font-size:10px;color:#a04030;padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(255,200,180,.4);border-radius:6px;border-left:2px solid #c41e3a}
.ct-punish-extra-label{font-size:8px;color:#a04030;margin-bottom:2px;font-weight:700}

.ct-roulette-btn{width:100%;margin-top:6px;padding:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6b6b,#ee5a5a);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
.ct-roulette-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.ct-roulette-btn.spinning .ic{animation:spin 0.4s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* 法官寄语 */
.ct-final-words{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,200,.85),rgba(255,225,170,.85));border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;text-align:center;color:#3d2b1f}
.ct-final-label{font-size:9px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}
.ct-final-body{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;font-style:italic;color:#5c4b3a}

/* 网友评论区 */
.ct-netizen-box{background:rgba(20,20,30,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.ct-netizen-title{font-size:9px;color:#ffd700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ct-hot-tag{font-size:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6b6b,#ee5a5a);color:#fff;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:6px;animation:hotPulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes hotPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.ct-netizen-item{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:9px}
.ct-netizen-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ct-netizen-avatar{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff}
.ct-netizen-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ct-netizen-user{font-size:8px;color:#ffd700;margin-bottom:1px;font-weight:600}
.ct-netizen-user .vip{color:#ff6b6b;font-size:7px;margin-left:2px}
.ct-netizen-text{font-size:9px;color:#fff8e8;line-height:1.4;opacity:.9}
.ct-netizen-like{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:2px;font-size:7px;color:#888}

/* 新闻报道 */
.ct-news{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#f0f0f0);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#222;position:relative;border:1px solid #ddd}
.ct-news-tag{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:8px;background:#ff0000;color:#fff;font-size:8px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.ct-news-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#000;line-height:1.4;margin:6px 0 4px;padding-right:50px}
.ct-news-content{font-size:9px;color:#555;line-height:1.5}
.ct-news-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:6px;padding-top:5px;border-top:1px solid #eee;font-size:7px;color:#999}

/* 上诉花样 */
.ct-appeal-style{background:rgba(160,140,200,.18);border:1px solid rgba(160,140,200,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ct-appeal-style-label{font-size:9px;color:#c0a8e0;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}
.ct-appeal-style-body{font-size:11px;color:#fff8e8;line-height:1.6}
.ct-appeal-style-tag{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(160,140,200,.3);color:#e0d0ff;font-size:8px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}

/* 和解礼包 */
.ct-peace-gift{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,200,220,.95),rgba(255,180,200,.95));border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f;text-align:center;border:2px dashed rgba(255,100,150,.4)}
.ct-peace-gift-title{font-size:11px;color:#c41e6e;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:1px}
.ct-peace-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;text-align:left}
.ct-peace-item{font-size:10px;color:#5c4b3a;padding:3px 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}

/* 按钮 */
.ct-btn-row{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ct-btn{flex:1;min-width:30%;padding:9px 6px;border-radius:18px;border:none;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:1px;transition:all .2s;font-family:inherit}
.ct-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.ct-btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);color:#3d2700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(255,176,0,.4)}
.ct-btn-outline{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#fff8e8}
.ct-btn-appeal{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a08cc8,#7d68a8);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(125,104,168,.3)}
.ct-btn-peace{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff8db4,#e85a8a);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(232,90,138,.3)}
.ct-btn.done{background:#999;color:#fff;pointer-events:none}

/* 底部导航 */
.ct-nav{flex-shrink:0;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,25,15,.95),rgba(20,12,8,.95));display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.2)}
.ct-nav .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit}
.ct-nav .item .ic{font-size:15px;line-height:1;opacity:.4;transition:all .2s}
.ct-nav .item .lb{font-size:7px;color:#a89070;letter-spacing:1px}
.ct-nav .item.on .ic{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,.6))}
.ct-nav .item.on .lb{color:#ffd700}
.ct-nav .item:active{transform:scale(.92)}

.ct-home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:999px;z-index:10}

/* 敲锤动画 */
.gavel-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;flex-direction:column;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.gavel-overlay.show{display:flex;animation:overlayFade .2s}
@keyframes overlayFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.gavel-icon{font-size:60px;animation:gavelDrop .6s ease-out}
@keyframes gavelDrop{0%{transform:translateY(-80px) rotate(-45deg);opacity:0}50%{transform:translateY(20px) rotate(20deg)}70%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);opacity:1}}
.gavel-text{color:#ffd700;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:3px;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,.6);animation:textShake .3s 0.5s}
@keyframes textShake{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}

/* Toast */
.ct-toast{position:absolute;bottom:60px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3d2700,#5c3a1f);color:#ffd700;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.3)}
.ct-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

/* 弹窗通用 */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:150;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.modal.show{display:flex;animation:modalFade .25s}
@keyframes modalFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.modal-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fdf6f0,#f5ebe0);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;color:#3d2b1f;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);max-width:240px;width:100%}
.modal-title{font-size:12px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:2px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.modal-content{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;color:#5c4b3a;text-align:left;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.modal-footer{font-size:7px;color:#a09080;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.modal-btns button{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600}
.modal-btns .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);color:#3d2700;border:none}
.modal-btns .secondary{background:transparent;border:1px solid #c4a070;color:#a07530}
.modal-card textarea{width:100%;height:90px;border:1px solid rgba(196,168,130,.3);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font-size:9px;font-family:inherit;color:#5c4b3a;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);resize:none;outline:none;line-height:1.5}

/* 闪光特效 */
.fx-burst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-size:24px;animation:burstFly 1.5s ease-out forwards;z-index:60}
@keyframes burstFly{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-70px) scale(.3) rotate(180deg)}}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
'use strict';

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function showToast(msg){var t=$('ctToast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show')},1800)}
function vibrate(ms){if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ms||30)}
function rand(arr){return arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)]}
function rnum(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min}

function spawnBurst(emoji,x,y){
  var dv=document.querySelector('.ct-device');
  var rect=dv.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++){
    var p=document.createElement('div');
    p.className='fx-burst';
    p.textContent=emoji;
    p.style.left=(x-rect.left+rnum(-20,20))+'px';
    p.style.top=(y-rect.top+rnum(-10,10))+'px';
    p.style.animationDelay=(i*0.08)+'s';
    dv.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(function(el){el.remove()},1700,p);
  }
}

var dataEl=$('ctData');
var raw=dataEl?dataEl.dataset:{};
function v(k,def){var s=raw[k];if(!s||String(s).trim().indexOf('{{')===0)return def;return String(s).trim()}

// 时间
var now=new Date();
$('ctTime').textContent=String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
$('caseNo').textContent='案件编号 #'+now.getFullYear()+'-'+String(rnum(1,999)).padStart(3,'0');

// 案件等级
var levelMap={'轻案':{ic:'🟢',cls:'ct-level-轻案'},'中案':{ic:'🟡',cls:'ct-level-中案'},'重案':{ic:'🟠',cls:'ct-level-重案'},'特大案':{ic:'🔴',cls:'ct-level-特大案'},'死刑级':{ic:'💀',cls:'ct-level-死刑级'}};
var caseLevel=v('case_level','中案');
var lvInfo=levelMap[caseLevel]||levelMap['中案'];
var levelBadge=$('levelBadge');
levelBadge.textContent=lvInfo.ic+' '+caseLevel;
levelBadge.className='ct-level-badge '+lvInfo.cls;

// 陪审员角色映射
var roleMap={
  '神婆':{av:'🧙‍♀️',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#a855f7,#7c3aed)'},
  '程序员':{av:'🧑‍💻',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#1d4ed8)'},
  '东北大妈':{av:'👵',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#d97706)'},
  '猫娘':{av:'🐱',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#ec4899,#db2777)'},
  '网红':{av:'🎤',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#f43f5e,#e11d48)'},
  '警察':{av:'👮',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#1e40af)'},
  '大厨':{av:'👨‍🍳',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#059669)'},
  '学者':{av:'👨‍🏫',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#4338ca)'},
  'AI机器人':{av:'🤖',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#64748b,#334155)'},
  '法官':{av:'🧑‍⚖️',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24,#f59e0b)'}
};
function setJuror(idx,role,name,text){
  var info=roleMap[role]||roleMap['法官'];
  var av=$('juror'+idx+'Av');
  av.textContent=info.av;
  av.style.background=info.bg;
  $('juror'+idx+'Name').textContent=name+' · '+role;
  $('jury'+idx).textContent=text;
}
setJuror(1,v('jury1_role','法官'),v('jury1_name','陪审员1'),v('jury1_text','—'));
setJuror(2,v('jury2_role','法官'),v('jury2_name','陪审员2'),v('jury2_text','—'));
setJuror(3,v('jury3_role','法官'),v('jury3_name','陪审员3'),v('jury3_text','—'));

// 法官风格
var judgeStyle=v('judge_style','铁面包公');
$('judgeStyleTag1').textContent=judgeStyle;
$('judgeStyleTag2').textContent=judgeStyle;

// 填充其他数据
$('courtName').textContent=v('court_name','恋爱审判庭');
$('caseTitle').textContent=v('case_title','—');
$('crime').textContent=v('crime','—');
$('caseStatement').textContent=v('case_statement','—');
$('evidence1').textContent=v('evidence1','📱 证物1：待补充');
$('evidence2').textContent=v('evidence2','📅 证物2：待补充');
$('evidence3').textContent=v('evidence3','🎮 证物3：待补充');
$('judgeOpening').textContent=v('judge_opening','—');
$('defenseSpeech').textContent=v('defense_speech','—');
$('lawQuote').textContent=v('law_quote','《恋爱关系法》第88条：恋人应当互相通报每日动向');
$('judgeReasoning').textContent=v('judge_reasoning','—');

var verdict=v('verdict','有罪');
var vBadge=$('verdictBadge');
vBadge.textContent=verdict;
if(verdict.indexOf('有罪')>-1||verdict.indexOf('成立')>-1)vBadge.className='ct-verdict-badge guilty';
else if(verdict.indexOf('无罪')>-1)vBadge.className='ct-verdict-badge innocent';
else vBadge.className='ct-verdict-badge partial';

$('verdictDetail').textContent=v('verdict_detail','—');
$('punishmentMain').textContent=v('punishment_main','—');
$('punishmentExtra').textContent=v('punishment_extra','—');
$('finalWords').textContent=v('final_words','—');

// 网友评论
var avatarColors=['linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2)','linear-gradient(135deg,#f093fb,#f5576c)','linear-gradient(135deg,#4facfe,#00f2fe)','linear-gradient(135deg,#43e97b,#38f9d7)','linear-gradient(135deg,#fa709a,#fee140)','linear-gradient(135deg,#30cfd0,#330867)'];
var emojis=['😂','🤣','💀','🤡','👀','🔥','😱','🥰','😭'];
var netizenHtml='';
for(var i=1;i<=5;i++){
  var u=v('netizen'+i+'_user','网友'+i);
  var t=v('netizen'+i+'_text','—');
  var isVip=Math.random()>0.6;
  var likes=rnum(23,8888);
  netizenHtml+='<div class="ct-netizen-item"><div class="ct-netizen-avatar" style="background:'+avatarColors[(i-1)%avatarColors.length]+'">'+rand(emojis)+'</div><div class="ct-netizen-info"><div class="ct-netizen-user">'+u+(isVip?'<span class="vip">👑VIP</span>':'')+'</div><div class="ct-netizen-text">'+t+'</div><div class="ct-netizen-like">❤️ '+likes+' · 💬 '+rnum(3,99)+' · '+rnum(1,59)+'分钟前</div></div></div>';
}
$('netizenList').innerHTML=netizenHtml;

// 新闻
$('newsTitle').textContent=v('news_title','—');

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  function $(s){ return document.querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s){ return document.querySelectorAll(s); }

  function esc(s){
    return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,''');
  }

  (function(){
    var n = new Date();
    document.getElementById('t').textContent = String(n.getHours()).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    var bat = Math.floor(70 + Math.random() * 30);
    var batEl = document.getElementById('bat');
    batEl.textContent = bat;
    if(bat <= 20) batEl.style.color = '#ff3c00';
  })();

  var isNight = false;
  var skinBtn = document.getElementById('skinBtn');
  skinBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    isNight = !isNight;
    var phone = document.getElementById('phone');
    if(isNight){ phone.classList.add('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '☀️'; }
    else { phone.classList.remove('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '🌙'; }
  });

  function getData(){
    var dataEl = document.getElementById('tbData');
    var raw = (dataEl && dataEl.dataset) ? dataEl.dataset : {};
    function v(k, def){
      var s = raw[k];
      if(s === undefined || s === null) return def;
      s = String(s).trim();
      if(!s || s.indexOf('{{') === 0) return def;
      return s;
    }
    var items = [];
    for(var i = 1; i <= 6; i++){
      var name = v('g'+i+'_name', '');
      var price = parseFloat(v('g'+i+'_price', '0')) || 0;
      var icon = v('g'+i+'_icon', '');
      if(name && price > 0 && icon){ items.push({ id: 'g'+i, name: name, price: price, icon: icon }); }
    }
    if(items.length === 0){
      var defaults = [
        { id:'d1', name:'舒适抱枕', price:39.9, icon:'🛏️' },
        { id:'d2', name:'保温杯', price:59.9, icon:'☕' },
        { id:'d3', name:'蓝牙耳机', price:129, icon:'🎧' },
        { id:'d4', name:'可爱手机壳', price:19.9, icon:'📱' },
        { id:'d5', name:'零食大礼包', price:49.9, icon:'🍪' },
        { id:'d6', name:'桌面小风扇', price:79, icon:'🌀' }
      ];
      items.push.apply(items, defaults);
    }
    var extraDefaults = [
      { id:'ex1', name:'香薰蜡烛', price:29.9, icon:'🕯️' },
      { id:'ex2', name:'卡通拖鞋', price:25.9, icon:'👟' }
    ];
    var me = {
      name: v('me_name', '用户'),
      avatar: v('me_avatar', '🐱'),
      whisper: v('me_whisper', '今天也是元气满满的一天~')
    };
    return { items: items, extraDefaults: extraDefaults, me: me };
  }

  var appData = getData();
  var items = appData.items;
  var extraDefaults = appData.extraDefaults;

  var bargainedPrices = {};
  var cart = [];
  var cartTotal = 0;
  var blindboxUsed = false;
  var blindboxItemId = null;

  var LINK_KEYWORDS = {

  function detectLinkEffects(cartItems){
    var effects = {};
    cartItems.forEach(function(item){
      Object.keys(LINK_KEYWORDS).forEach(function(kw){
        if(item.name.indexOf(kw) !== -1){
          var eff = LINK_KEYWORDS[kw];
          if(!effects[eff.key]) effects[eff.key] = { delta: 0, labels: [] };
          effects[eff.key].delta += eff.delta;
          if(effects[eff.key].labels.indexOf(eff.label) === -1) effects[eff.key].labels.push(eff.label);
        }
      });
    });
    return effects;
  }

  function checkout(){
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    var parts = [];
    var total = 0;
    cart.forEach(function(i){
      var isFree = (blindboxItemId && i.id === blindboxItemId);

    var effects = detectLinkEffects(cart);

    var match = p0.match(/告诉(.+?)你偷懒/);

    // 兜底：从其他短语提取

      var m2 = p.match(/(.+?)说/);
      if(m2 && m2[1] && m2[1] !== '{{char}}') return m2[1];
      var m3 = p.match(/告诉(.+?)你/);

      var m4 = p.match(/欠(.+?)一次/);

      var m5 = p.match(/(.+?)刚才/);

      var m6 = p.match(/(.+?)快来/);

    wishList.push({ name: name, price: price.toFixed(2) });
    nameInput.value = ''; priceInput.value = '';
    renderWishList();
  });

  function buildCharCart(){
    var charName = getCharName();
    document.getElementById('charCartName').textContent = charName;
    var shuffled = items.slice().sort(function(){ return Math.random() - 0.5; });
    var charItems = shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(3, shuffled.length));
    var listEl = document.getElementById('charCartList');
    var html = '';
    charItems.forEach(function(ci){
      html += '<div class="cc-item"><span class="cc-icon">' + esc(ci.icon) + '</span><span class="cc-name">' + esc(ci.name) + '</span><span class="cc-price">¥' + ci.price.toFixed(2) + '</span></div>';
    });
    listEl.innerHTML = html;
    listEl._charItems = charItems;
    listEl._charName = charName;
  }

  document.getElementById('charCartSendBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var listEl = document.getElementById('charCartList');
    var charItems = listEl._charItems || [];
    var charName = listEl._charName || 'Char';
    if(charItems.length === 0) return;
    var parts = charItems.map(function(ci){ return '「' + ci.name + '」¥' + ci.price.toFixed(2); }).join('、');
    var total = charItems.reduce(function(s, ci){ return s + ci.price; }, 0);
    var msg = '（我帮' + charName + '清空了购物车：' + parts + '，一共 ¥' + total.toFixed(2) + '！\n' + charName + '你买了这些是要干嘛呀~）';
    try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: msg }, '*'); } catch(e) {}
  });

  function switchTab(tab){
    $$('.page').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
    var target = document.getElementById('page-' + tab);
    if(target) target.classList.add('active');
    $$('.b-bar .item').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('on'); });
    var btn = document.querySelector('.b-bar .item[data-tab="' + tab + '"]');
    if(btn) btn.classList.add('on');
    if(tab === 'cart') renderCart();
  }

  $$('.b-bar .item').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchTab(this.dataset.tab); });
  });

  var cdSec = 23 * 3600 + 59 * 60 + 59;
  setInterval(function(){
    if(cdSec <= 0) cdSec = 24 * 3600;
    cdSec--;
    var hh = String(Math.floor(cdSec / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
    var mm = String(Math.floor((cdSec % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    var ss = String(cdSec % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    var el = document.getElementById('countdown');
    if(el) el.textContent = hh + ':' + mm + ':' + ss;
  }, 1000);

  function init(){
    updateCartBadge();
    renderCart();
    buildTicker();
    renderWishList();
    buildCharCart();
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else { init(); }
})();
</script>
</body>
